I'll start by reading the docs and surveying the layout.

Spawn errors are intermittent; I'll retry.

Pid 487877 held the port at the time of the failure (02:50:17), and it was released at 02:50:27.

`tagging` failed to bind its admin port 9446 during deploy d-1197, because `transcode` still held that port. I've written `/app/answer.json` and `/app/STATUS.json` (status `success`).

```json
{"deploy": "d-1197", "failing_service": "tagging", "port": 9446, "conflicts_with": "transcode"}
```

- **Deploy:** This host is app-07 in prod-b. d-1197 (apply, `hosts = all`) is the latest apply run that started services on it. d-1198 was cancelled before it reached app-07, and d-1200 and d-1203 are dry runs. d-1202 doesn't target app-07 (it covers app-05, app-06 and app-08).
- **Config revision:** The record asks for config revision 418, but app-07 loaded 417 because the fetch of r0418 failed with a checksum mismatch. The failure has to be read against 417, not the latest config.
- **Service that failed:** The only failed pid on app-07 in d-1197 was 498202, which is `tagging`. Its log shows `listener main ready`, then `listener admin: bind failed: address already in use`, then `startup aborted`, all at about 02:50:17Z.
- **Port:** Resolving tagging's config as of 417, the last `admin_port` for it is 9446, set in `environments/prod-b.conf` by r0417. r0418's later change to 9452 was never loaded.
- **Holder:** The port events show `transcode` (pid 487877) bound 9446 on 2026-03-20 and released it at 02:50:27Z, ten seconds after tagging's bind failed. Services run in alphabetical order, so `transcode` was still running its old process when `tagging` started.

I didn't run any other verification beyond these lookups.

command_result.command: cd /app; find . -type f | head -200; echo; cat docs/*
cd /app; cat etc/*; ls bin logs; cat config-history/INDEX; cd deploy/records; cat d-1203.rec d-1202.rec; grep -l 'apply' * | wc -l
cd /app/deploy/records; grep -l 'environment = prod-b' * | while read f; do echo "== $f"; grep -vE '^(id|release|requested_by)' $f | tr '\n' ';'; echo; done | tail -60
cd /app; bin/statusd --background; sleep 2; for d in d-1197 d-1198 d-1202 d-1196; do echo $d; bin/statusctl run app-07 $d; done; for h in app-05 app-06 app-08; do bin/statusctl run $h d-1197; done
cd /app; bin/statusctl proc app-07 498202; grep -l 'startup aborted' logs/*.log logs/*.1; zcat logs/*.gz | grep -c 'startup aborted'; grep -h -B3 'startup aborted' logs/*.log | head -40

cd /app; cat services/tagging/service.conf; cat config/environments/prod-b.conf config/hosts/app-07.conf; ls config-history/r0418 config-history/r0419; cat config-history/r0418/CHANGES config-history/r0419/CHANGES
cd /app; cat services/tagging/service.conf; echo ----; cat config/environments/prod-b.conf; echo ----; cat config/hosts/app-07.conf
cd /app; grep -rn 'include\|admin_port\|^\[tagging\]\|port_base\|port_offset' config/profiles/edge.conf config/shared config/overrides | head -60
cd /app/config-history; cat r0418/CHANGES; ls -R r0418 r0419 r0417 | head -30; echo; cat /app/config/profiles/edge.conf

cd /app/config-history; diff r0418/prev/profiles/edge.conf /app/config/profiles/edge.conf; cat /app/config/shared/limits.conf | grep -n 'admin\|port\|include\|^\['; grep -n 'include\|admin_port\|port_' /app/config/hosts/app-07.conf /app/config/environments/prod-b.conf

cd /app/config; grep -n '^\[' environments/prod-b.conf | awk -F: '$1>300' | head -80; sed -n 885,900p environments/prod-b.conf; sed -n 724,730p environments/prod-b.conf; sed -n 765,771p environments/prod-b.conf;  sed -n 1566,1590p environments/prod-b.conf

cd /app; echo '{"deploy": "d-1197", "failing_service": "tagging", "port": 9446, "conflicts_with": "transcode"}' > answer.json; echo '{"status": "success", "summary": "Identified d-1197 as the latest apply run that started services on app-07 (loaded rev 417 after the r0418 fetch failed). tagging failed to bind admin port 9446, held by transcode pid 487877; answer written to /app/answer.json."}' > STATUS.json; cat answer.json STATUS.json
